thread:
emma (support): BetaCorp reported a spike in storage/billing. They say objects with default 30d retention DIDN'T tombstone after TTL and are still searchable. Logs show `delete_task -> kms.Decrypt: access denied (403)` for many object_ids. Anyone seen this pattern?

diego (support): customer provided a sample obj id: obj_9a7b2c. Billing shows +$1.2k storage in last 24h. They claim they did NOT change retention.

raj (eng): thanks — first suspicion: key access error during purge. Is BetaCorp on CMK or Redwood-managed key?

emma (support): they said CMK in their account (customer-managed key). They attached an audit log snippet: `2026-03-10T18:12:45Z delete_task obj_9a7b2c -> error: kms.Decrypt: access denied (403) key: projects/retail-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring-1/cryptoKeys/rc-retention`

olivia (security): fyi there was an HSM/rotation rolling update on 2026-03-10 (maintenance window). We need to confirm key ACLs weren't reset during rotation. I'll pull KMS audit entries.

raj (eng): can you ask for minimal repro? steps we need: tenant id, object ids, exact API calls that trigger purge, and any recent key policy changes. Also need a stacktrace or full error blob.

emma (support): shared repro request with customer, included this quick curl they used to trigger a manual purge:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/purge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer XXXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object_id":"obj_9a7b2c","force":true}'
```

raj (eng): good. also have them run this from their side to fetch deletion-queue state (we can confirm backlog):```
# internal: show head of deletion queue
redis-cli -h deletion-redis-01 LRANGE deletion_queue 0 50 | sed -n '1,10p'
```

emma (support): done. customer ran and sent back first 5 entries, shows many obj ids with same 403.

olivia (security): I'm seeing KMS DENY entries overlapping the maintenance window. Need to verify IAM binding for service account used by deletion worker. @raj can you check whether deletion-worker SA was temporarily replaced during rollout?

raj (eng): looking. Deletion worker SA is `svc-deleter@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. IAM logs show a rebind event at 2026-03-10T18:11:30Z where `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` was briefly removed from that SA on the key `rc-retention` for ~90s. That matches the failures.

hana (billing): bride note — because deletes failed the objects kept accruing storage, customer billed ~+$1.2k. BetaCorp is asking for credit for the gap window.

diego (support): action items: 1) @raj to confirm scope & reapply proper IAM bindings and confirm no remaining 403s; 2) @olivia to file security postmortem for key ACL drift during maintenance; 3) @hana to estimate credit and hold a note for customer comms.

raj (eng): rebinding now and will tail logs. Quick repro command we can use once IAM is fixed:```
# trigger background purge for an object
POST /v1/admin/purge {"object_id":"obj_9a7b2c"}
# then poll deletion status
GET /v1/objects/obj_9a7b2c/status
```

deploy-bot: Deployment "hsm-rotation-2026-03-10" started at 2026-03-10T18:00:00Z and completed at 2026-03-10T18:14:00Z.

olivia (security): I've created ticket SEC-2026-451 to track root cause and regulatory implications (audit log gaps). Adding BetaCorp as affected customer.

raj (eng): IAM re-applied at 1766429405, retesting purge for obj_9a7b2c now.

emma (support): customer just confirmed a successful purge for obj_9a7b2c — status now `deleted` and object no longer appears in search. They requested ETA on full backfill of backlog.

raj (eng): we'll run a bounded backfill. Estimated catch-up time ~3 hours for this tenant (throttle set to preserve SLOs). I'll post updates to this thread.

hana (billing): starting credit calc for 2026-03-10T18:11:00Z -> 2026-03-10T18:14:30Z window. Will propose a pro-rated credit.

diego (support): thanks team. I'll tell BetaCorp we're on it: patch applied, purge confirmed for sample, backfill ETA ~3h, security follow-up and billing credit being prepared. :thumbsup:
